# Quaternius Ultimate Monsters

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemonsters.html
- Download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18m4KpzpEzhC9wl7jzr6dUc0N8Jozr79C
- License: CC0 1.0; see `LICENSE.txt`.
- Retrieved: 2026-08-20.

This project includes only the five glTF models needed by the current enemy
archetypes, plus the source palette texture. The glTF files embed their material
images; Godot extracts the `*_Atlas_Monsters.png` files during import.

- `Alien.gltf`
- `BlueDemon.gltf`
- `MushroomKing.gltf`
- `Orc_Skull.gltf`
- `Yeti.gltf`
- `Atlas_Monsters.png`

The bundled license file uses the title "Ultimate Platformer Pack" but grants
CC0 terms. The official Ultimate Monsters page above is the provenance record
for these selected files.
